xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The business activity of the Company falls within a single primary business segment viz ‘Investments and financing Activities’ and hence there is no other reportable segment as per Ind AS 108 ‘operating segments’.

2.The above financial results of the group have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (‘Ind AS') notified under the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 as amended by the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2016, prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act 2013 (‘the Act’) read with relevant rules issued thereunder and the other accounting principles generally accepted in India. Any application guidance/ clarifications/ directions issued by the Reserve Bank of India or other regulators are implemented as and when they are issued/ applicable.

3.Current Quarter results include dividend of Rs 2974 lakhs received on shares held by the Company, therefore results for the quarter do not necessarily represent annual performance of the Company.

4.The above results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their meetings held on 30th October 2026.

5.The members at the Annual General Meeting held on July 31, 2026, approved the payment of final dividend of Rs 2.5 per equity share aggregating to Rs.264.90 Lakhs for the year ended March 31, 2026 as recommended by Board of Directors of the Company as its Meeting held on 12 May, 2026. Accordingly, the dividend amount has been paid to the shareholders in August 2026.

6.On 21 November 2025, the Government of India notified the provisions relating to the Code on Wages, 2019, the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, the Code on Social Security, 2020 and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (collectively referred to as the “Labour Codes”), which subsume various existing labour laws; the Group has carried out a preliminary assessment of the impact of the said Labour Codes and, based on the current evaluation, expects that the financial impact on the financial statements will not be material, however, the Group will continue to monitor developments, including notification of relevant rules and clarifications by the Government, and will recognise the impact, if any, in the period in which the related rules become effective and the impact can be reasonably estimated.

7.The figures for the previous periods have been regrouped/ rearranged, wherever considered necessary, to confirm current period classifications.
